domain_notes.fields: 2026-07-09: Duration field API input now follows Baserow backend semantics for string and numeric values. Worker row writes and field conversions parse Baserow duration strings such as h:mm, h:mm:ss(.sss), d h, d h:mm, d h:mm:ss, space-suffixed forms like 1h 2m, negative values and Postgres interval strings, then round by duration_format before storing seconds in D1. Date parsing uses Baserow-style date_format handling: ISO strings are parsed first, EU numeric dates are day-first, US numeric dates are month-first, ISO slash dates are year-first, AM/PM datetimes are supported, and impossible numeric dates such as 31/02/2026 are rejected instead of silently overflowing.
